parameters_for_code_generation.description: Code-generation-ready parameter definitions for CadQuery-based Python generator

BaseWidth.validation: if not (100 <= value <= 300 and value % 10 == 0): raise ValueError('Width must be 100-300, divisible by 10')

BaseDepth.comment: Standard post connector depth - not user configurable

BaseThickness.validation: if not (8 <= value <= 12): raise ValueError('Thickness must be 8-12mm')

CornerRadius.cli_help: External corner radius in mm (1.5-3, step 0.5, min 1.5 for FDM)
CornerRadius.validation: if not (1.5 <= value <= 3): raise ValueError('Corner radius must be 1.5-3mm')

MountingHoleDiameter.cli_help: M3 bolt hole diameter in mm (3.0-3.5, tolerance ±0.1)
MountingHoleDiameter.validation: if not (3.0 <= value <= 3.5): raise ValueError('Hole diameter must be 3.0-3.5mm for M3 bolts')

MinWallThickness.cli_help: Minimum wall thickness in mm (1.5-3, step 0.5, do not go below 1.5)
MinWallThickness.validation: if value < 1.5: raise ValueError('Wall thickness < 1.5mm causes structural failure. Minimum is 1.5mm.')

RibHeight.cli_help: Reinforcement rib height in mm (3-8, step 1)
RibHeight.validation: if not (3 <= value <= 8): raise ValueError('Rib height must be 3-8mm')

TaperFactor.description: Wall taper scale factor for middle sections

cli_interface.usage: python generate_shelfbracket.py [--width W] [--thickness T] [--corner-radius R] [--hole-diameter D] [--wall-thickness W] [--rib-height H] [--output FILE]

pre_generation: Check all parameter values within min/max ranges
post_generation: Verify model has exactly 1 solid body
Check all mounting holes are through-holes
Validate wall thickness in thin sections >= MinWallThickness
Check bounding box dimensions match parameters

code_structure.main_function: def generate_bracket(BaseWidth, BaseThickness, CornerRadius, MountingHoleDiameter, MinWallThickness, RibHeight) -> CQ
